dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver/baseimage-alpine:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG LIDARR_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="Roxedus,thespad"

# environment settings
ARG LIDARR_BRANCH="master"
ENV XDG_CONFIG_HOME="/config/xdg" \
  COMPlus_EnableDiagnostics=0 \
  TMPDIR=/run/lidarr-temp

RUN \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apk add -U --upgrade --no-cache \
    chromaprint \
    icu-libs \
    krb5-libs \
    sqlite-libs \
    xmlstarlet && \
  echo "**** install lidarr ****" && \
  mkdir -p /app/lidarr/bin && \
  if [ -z ${LIDARR_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    LIDARR_RELEASE=$(curl -sL "https://lidarr.servarr.com/v1/update/${LIDARR_BRANCH}/changes?runtime=netcore&os=linuxmusl" \
    | jq -r '.[0].version'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/lidarr.tar.gz -L \
    "https://lidarr.servarr.com/v1/update/${LIDARR_BRANCH}/updatefile?version=${LIDARR_RELEASE}&os=linuxmusl&runtime=netcore&arch=x64" && \
  tar xzf \
    /tmp/lidarr.tar.gz -C \
    /app/lidarr/bin --strip-components=1 && \
  echo -e "UpdateMethod=docker\nBranch=${LIDARR_BRANCH}\nPackageVersion=${VERSION}\nPackageAuthor=[linuxserver.io](https://linuxserver.io)" > /app/lidarr/package_info && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    /app/lidarr/bin/Lidarr.Update \
    /tmp/*

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8686

VOLUME /config

units.name: init-lidarr-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

mkdir -p /run/lidarr-temp

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /config \
        /run/lidarr-temp
fi

units.name: svc-lidarr
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 \
            cd /app/lidarr/bin s6-setuidgid abc /app/lidarr/bin/Lidarr \
            -nobrowser -data=/config
else
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 \
            cd /app/lidarr/bin  /app/lidarr/bin/Lidarr \
            -nobrowser -data=/config
fi
